summary: Eastern Europe, software developer, extensive experience with .NET and C#, game development background, strong interest in operating systems and microservices architecture, prefers Windows for development, critical of Linux as a desktop OS, advocates for functional programming (F#), skeptical of JavaScript frameworks, values code quality and performance, believes in the importance of algorithms and data structures, critical of Agile methodologies, interested in financial markets and investing, prefers practical over theoretical knowledge, emphasizes the importance of meaningful discussions in interviews, critical of corporate practices in tech, values privacy and is skeptical of big tech companies, has lived in multiple countries, including a poor Eastern European country.
